messages:
morgan_fin: Heads-up  NovaHealth (acct NH-621) disputed INV-2026-5022 claiming our partner applied an unauthorized 20% uplift. They want a retroactive adjustment (approx $27,600) and Net60 for future invoices while partner audit completes. Can we approve an exception?

ash_sales: Customer opened a ticket. Partner routed traffic through a managed routing rule that added extra inference hops; partner admits config error but says markup was partner-side, not NovaHealth. Customer is high-value; risk of churn if we don't act fast.

tina_revops: Key constraints: credits > $10k need deal desk sign-off; payment-term changes >30 days require finance + legal sign-off. Also need to confirm revenue recognition impact if we change terms.

rachael_legal: We'll need a short amendment: 1) one-time credit applied to INV-2026-5022 only, 2) temporary Net60 approved through 2026-09-30, 3) partner to accept audit results before further concessions. No lasting repricing.

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2026-119 created for $27,600. Approval: pending finance + exec.

morgan_fin: Quick ask to CFO/executive: is exec exception available here? This is one-off to retain strategic payer; estimated renewal ARR = ~$420k.

lina_ceo: I'm okay approving the full $27,600 credit and temporary Net60 through quarter end, provided legal signs the amendment and partner commits to the audit within 10 business days. Marking as CEO-approved exception.

rachael_legal: Noted. Drafting amendment now with explicit clause: "This credit and payment-term extension are one-time accommodations tied to audit acceptance; no change to standard pricing or future invoices."

tina_revops: Finance follow-ups: GL code 7302 for contra-revenue; NetSuite memo must reference CEO exception and partner audit link. Billing to post CM-2026-119 after legal attaches amendment.

morgan_fin: Thanks all. I'll notify NovaHealth that we will apply the credit once the amendment is countersigned and will temporarily accept Net60 through 2026-09-30.

ash_sales: I'll coordinate partner alert and escalation. We want partner to cover any confirmed partner-side markup if audit finds misconduct.

billing-bot: Action items logged: attach amendment to CM-2026-119, post credit after countersignature, NetSuite memo update.

morgan_fin: Resolving thread after CM posts. Appreciate the quick turnaround :pray:
